title: LIBRE Regional Field Manager, South East Wisconsin
description:
Rooted in the Hispanic community, The LIBRE Initiative brings people together to advance public policy solutions that create the freedom and opportunity that people need to chase their American Dream.  LIBRE empowers our communities by fixing our broken immigration system, encouraging affordable and flexible healthcare options, building an individualized education system, and promoting a robust economy that helps everyone succeed. 
 
The LIBRE Initiative is a part of Americans for Prosperity and the Stand Together philanthropic community. 

As a Regional Field Manager (internally referred to as a Grassroots Engagement Director) you will identify, recruit, and engage grassroots leaders in the Green Bay area, mobilize them to take action, and drive policy reforms that open opportunities for all. 

Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.   
 
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success.  That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

title: AI Tutor - Lithuanian
description:

This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Tutor specialized in multilingual audio capabilities, you will contribute to SpaceXAI's mission by training and refining Grok to excel in voice interactions, speech recognition, and auditory experiences across diverse languages, accents, and cultural contexts. Your work will focus on curating and annotating high-quality audio data to enhance Grok's global accessibility, enabling natural spoken interactions for users worldwide, bridging language barriers through accurate speech processing, and improving the AI's handling of multilingual audio nuances.

• Use proprietary software to provide labels, annotations, recordings, and inputs on projects involving multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, speech samples, and auditory elements in various languages.

• Work with technical staff to improve annotation tools for efficient audio workflows.

• Native proficiency in Lithuanian  with exposure to diverse accents, dialects, or regional variations.

• Proficiency in English (minimum B2 level) with clear, natural vocal delivery and pronunciation suitable for audio recording purposes.

• Demonstrated ability to handle multilingual audio content, including evaluating speech accuracy, cultural vocal expressions, and contextual interpretation in spoken form.

• Demonstrated ability to transcribe audio with high accuracy across accents and varying audio quality.

• Demonstrated ability to translate and localize text accurately between English and Lithuanian, preserving meaning, tone, and cultural nuance.

• Comfort providing high-quality voice recordings and feedback on audio samples in multiple languages.

• Commitment to developing AI that masters sophisticated multilingual audio capabilities.

• Demonstration of exceptional attention to linguistic nuance, auditory detail, and data quality beyond standard transcription work.

• Deep understanding and taste of what good/useful Audio data is.

title: Sr Associate, Underwriter
description:
SUMMARY:
Incumbent will possess strong automated and simplified issue underwriting skills to assess risk from insurance applicants on new business, contract changes, and reinstatements to make fair, consistent, and appropriate decisions in accordance with our underwriting guidelines, process and within legal and regulatory guidelines. This is not a traditional underwriting position as the incumbent should be more proficient in automated, simplified issue underwriting.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Familiarity with automated, simplified issue underwriting process, including working with the industry vendors who support such process.

• Assess data and make issue decisions based on established risk guidelines

• Review/analyze policy information and applications on contestable claims

• Strong data mining ability, including outside data resources and internal analytics

• Update current knowledge/obtain continuing education on life mortality and its effects upon risk selection

• Direct reinsurance submissions, coordinate processing with vendors

• Work with other departments on underwriting projects and initiatives

• Work with the chief underwriter on improving data reporting, analytic intelligence and metrics around underwriting production

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree in related major preferred

• LOMA ALMI+ preferred

• FALU or AALU preferred

• 3-5 Years Minimum Simplified Issue Life Underwriting experience required

• Familiarity with life insurance enterprise systems desired

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE:

• Strong analytical skills

• Demonstrated ability to effectively learn and utilize information systems

• Proficient in use of Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, etc.)

• Quick learner and critical thinker

• Ability to bring new ideas and ways of thinking

• Ability to speak and present on underwriting information to a broader audience

• Confidence in decision making ability

• Empathy and care for the company mission and policy holders

COMPETENCIES:
Drive - Displays motivation, is proactive and resourceful in daily work. Persists to complete responsibilities, even in the face of difficulties, is optimistic and tenacious throughout.
Collaboration - Able to actively listen to others and build relationships and trust, effectively handle conflict, and interact with tact and respect. Articulates ideas and concerns so others are able to understand and is sensitive to others and is able to adapt to different types of individuals.
Able to cooperate and collaborate with colleagues to achieve shared goals and encourages others and seeks out opportunities to collaborate across the business.
Adaptable - Willingly adapts to constantly changing circumstances while maintaining perspective. Engaging in continuous learning, adjusting the application of knowledge, skills and abilities while addressing new challenges. Accepts constructive feedback.
Responsible - Follows through on commitments; clearly defines mutual expectations of selves and others. Responds to demands of job by accepting responsibility for assignments, shows initiative and takes timely and appropriate actions to meet needs.

Knows both technical and practical aspects of the job and continually updates skills and knowledge.

description:

With a national footprint,cutting-edgetechnology, and a strong commitment to innovation and patient-centered care, our teams play a vital role in improving outcomes for millions of patients each year.
We are hiring for a Human Resources Generalist to join our team. This will be a full-time, remote position, located in the United States.
The HR Generalist provides essential day-to-day operational support to the mobile imaging and fixed-site oncology teams. Serving as the initial point of contact for team members and frontline managers on HR-related matters, this role is critical to ensuring policy and process execution. The HR Generalist handles employee relations intake, supports annual HR programs, and partners with functional HR operations to deliver seamless support. This position ensures HR practices embody the organization’s core values: Care, Collaboration, and Excellence.

title: Senior Product Manager (US - ET)
description:
Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Senior Product Manager at Chooose , you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

This role reports to the CTO.

This is a remote role that must be based in Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida

What you’ll do

• Own the vision, roadmap and execution for a Chooose domain, balancing intuition with data

• Deeply understand the aviation fuel market and our customers’ needs by spending time with customers

• Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

• Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

• Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

• Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

• BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

• Minimum 4 years of product management or adjacent product-building experience in an enterprise context

• Strong customer empathy and design thinking

• Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on tools

• Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems, such as prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

• Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments (Figma)

• Fluency in data and experimentation, and understanding when the answer cannot be found in the data

• Proven ability to lead small, technical teams toward ambitious product goals with urgency

• Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, synthesizing complex systems into compelling narratives

• Native-level English writing and speaking skills

Not for you if

• You prefer product strategy briefings over hands-on delivery

• You’re not building with AI

Nice to have

• Experience building in financial, enterprise, or other compliance-heavy domains requiring precision and complex systems thinking

• Experience in high growth startups

• Experience getting results on a distributed team

title: Product Marketing Manager - Growly
description:

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку Product Marketing Manager для нашої портфельної компанії Growly.

Про бізнес Growly:

Growly - глобальна продуктова компанія, яку рухають виняткові команди.

Наш принцип простий: ніхто не перемагає наодинці. Змінюються продукти і ринки - але сильна команда досягає результатів знову і знову. Тому для нас не так важливо, що робити. Важливо - з ким, ми збираємо команди, які разом перетворюють амбітні ідеї на реальність.

Сьогодні ми розвиваємо три напрями в межах одного бренду:
- Інструменти для роботи з документами - редагування, конвертація, підписання і захист файлів в одному місці.
- Платформа для розвитку когнітивних навичок - тренування памʼяті, уваги та швидкості мислення через науково обґрунтовані тести й практики.
- Платформа для розвитку карʼєри - резюме та мотиваційні листи, пошук вакансій і підтримка на кожному етапі карʼєрного розвитку.

Класні продукти будують не вакансії, а люди. Тому ми не «закриваємо позицію» - ми шукаємо людину, яка підніме планку команди - можливо, це ти.

Це роль, в якій ти будеш:
- Працювати з маркетинг-воронками з фокусом на пошукову рекламу;
- Вести та розвивати процес A/B-тестування - PMM відповідає за повний цикл A/B-тесту: від генерації та пріоритезації гіпотез до дизайну експерименту, запуску, координації із залученими командами, аналізу результатів та оцінки ефекту;
- Проводити конкурентний аналіз та шукати insights - системно відслідковувати конкурентів, ринок та поведінку користувачів, виявляти нові можливості для зростання;
- Тісно співпрацювати з командами product, marketing, контенту, дизайну та розробки для реалізації маркетингових ініціатив та тестів.

Що для нас важливо:
- Сильні аналітичні здібності - досвід роботи з даними, статистикою, метриками; вміння бачити за цифрами потребу юзера та робити висновки;
- Дослідження ринку та пошук інсайтів - вміння знаходити, що насправді болить у користувача, і трансформувати це у меседжі та value proposition;
- Практичний підхід до гіпотез - здатність оцінювати пріоритет та потенційний імпакт гіпотези;
- Комунікаційні навички - вміння пояснити свої ідеї команді так, щоб їх зрозуміли і підхопили;
- Гнучкість і проактивність - вміння працювати у швидкому та висококонкурентному середовищі, де ринок і кампанії змінюються кожен тиждень.

Як ми працюємо - наші цінності

Openness - Be Brave. Embrace Change. Value Feedback.
Сміливість говорити правду й чути інших - навіть коли незручно.

Ownership - Take charge. Deliver results.
Тут не питають «де мій KPI» - тут приходять з «я бачу, як зробити краще».

Bias for Action - Quick Moves, Big Wins.

Growth - Evolve Today, Excel Tomorrow.
Ми не зупиняємось на досягнутому - ні як бізнес, ні як люди. Ставимо високу планку й щодня рухаємось до неї.

title: Regional Director - New England (MA/NH)

You will take ownership of the most important opportunities in your region. There is no fully built machine here. You will help create it.

This is not an EA role, and not a narrow sales or marketing role - it's a hands-on operator role for someone who can take an ambiguous business problem, structure it, and drive it to a result, working directly with the founders.

Partnerships, developer community, recruiting, and market research all sit on the founders' plates today, alongside product and engineering. We need someone to own that surface area - not run a fixed playbook, but build one as they go.

- Strong communication and relationship-building, with real follow-through

- Excellent research, synthesis, and structured thinking

- Operates in ambiguity without waiting for perfect instructions

- Willing to do unglamorous, high-value work

- Genuine interest in healthcare workflows, and the ability to learn the space fast

Nice to have

- Venture capital or business/strategy team experience

- Prior healthcare exposure

What you get

title: Directeur Sénior, Livraison et exécution
description:

Relevant du Vice-Président, Recherche et Développement, le Directeur Sénior, Livraison et exécution est le responsable unique de la livraison de l’organisation Recherche et Développement. Le poste a été créé pour établir une redevabilité claire de l’exécution, là où la coordination de plusieurs directions et le suivi des projets majeurs dépassaient la capacité d’un seul palier. Le titulaire ne coordonne pas la livraison : il en est comptable.

Le titulaire supervise également les projets majeurs menés avec des partenaires et intégrateurs externes, et porte la relation d’exécution avec ces fournisseurs.
Leader autonome et hautement motivé, il valorise le succès collectif, la satisfaction des clients et la rigueur d’exécution. Il opère dans un environnement bilingue, francophone et anglophone, en mode télétravail, au sein d’une organisation de solutions logicielles destinées au réseau de la santé au Québec.
Ce poste offre l’occasion de bâtir la fonction de livraison d’une organisation R&D en pleine transformation, avec un mandat explicite pour en redéfinir les façons de faire.
Responsabilités principales

•
Redevabilité de la livraison :

• Répondre des engagements de livraison de l’ensemble du portefeuille R&D - échéanciers, qualité, portée et budget - devant la direction et devant les clients.

• Arbitrer les priorités et l’affectation de la capacité entre les cinq directions lorsque les engagements entrent en conflit.

• Détecter les dérives avant qu’elles soient rapportées, et intervenir au bon niveau.

•
Direction d’une équipe de directeurs :

• Diriger, encadrer et développer les cinq directeurs de la R&D : objectifs, évaluation, plans de développement et gestion de la performance.

• Établir un cadre de délégation explicite : ce qui se décide chez les directeurs et ce qui remonte.

• Développer la relève de gestion au sein de l’organisation.

•
Gouvernance de l’exécution :

• Définir et opérer les indicateurs de livraison : respect des engagements, cadence, capacité, qualité et dette technique.

• Instrumenter le suivi d’avancement de façon automatisée plutôt que par de la collecte manuelle.

• Produire pour la direction une lecture fiable et régulière de l’état d’avancement du portefeuille.

Transformation de la livraison :

• Concevoir et piloter la transformation des façons de livrer, incluant l’application de l’IA au travail d’ingénierie, d’assurance qualité et de gestion de projet.

• Établir les garde-fous d’un usage responsable de l’IA - qualité, traçabilité, protection des renseignements de santé - mesurer les gains de capacité obtenus et en rendre compte à la direction.

• Assurer la livraison des projets majeurs menés avec des fournisseurs et intégrateurs externes.

• Porter la relation d’exécution avec ces partenaires : engagements, escalades et révisions de portée.

Collaboration interfonctionnelle :

• Travailler étroitement avec Croissance et innovation, Services techniques, Sécurité et qualité, ainsi qu’avec les équipes de service à la clientèle et de vente.

title: Developer Relations Manager – Data Processing and Databases
description:
NVIDIA is building GPU acceleration for the analytical data processing ecosystem: the query engines, data platforms, and processing frameworks that the world runs its analytics on. Making that real means embedding an acceleration layer inside engines we do not own. Each of those engines has its own optimizer, scheduler, memory model, and exchange, and each one draws the line between "adopt your component" and "keep mine" in a different place. Nobody has settled what that integration surface should look like. That is the problem this role owns. We are looking for someone with genuine depth in how analytical data systems are built: query planning and processing, columnar and vectorized processing, storage formats, or the internals of a SQL engine.
You will work with the maintainers, architects, and engineering leaders behind these systems, in public where the project is open and directly where it is not, on how acceleration lands in what they ship. You will produce the benchmark evidence that shows whether it worked, and turn what you learn into concrete requirements for NVIDIA 's roadmap. This is a developer relations role rather than an engineering role because the leverage is breadth. An engineer improves one engine. This role shapes how acceleration lands across the ecosystem and influences which parts of it get there first.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Build and deepen technical expertise in analytical data processing, including query execution and optimization, columnar and vectorized processing, and distributed execution. Serve as a technical advocate and trusted resource for the developers building and operating these systems, working with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies such as Sirius, cuCascade, RAPIDS, cuDF, nvCOMP, and CUDA-X Data Processing.

• Demonstrate and integrate NVIDIA 's data processing stack (libraries, SDKs, and tools) into real query engines and OLAP databases, carrying the work from prototype through to a functioning, measured integration across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments.

• Support developers, projects, and partners through onboarding and integration by providing working reference implementations, integration guides, and direct hands-on engineering help, so that a first integration produces a real accelerated query path rather than a demo.

• Track the analytical data processing ecosystem: new engines, execution models, storage formats, and competing approaches to acceleration. Share what you learn with NVIDIA engineering, product, marketing, and the worldwide field organization to shape adoption strategy.

• Collaborate with engine architects and NVIDIA engineering to resolve integration problems, establish best-practice patterns, and feed concrete technical requirements back to NVIDIA product teams.

• Define the integration surface between NVIDIA 's GPU data processing libraries and third-party query engines: where the plan handoff occurs, how execution and memory ownership are divided, and which of a partner's differentiating components remain in place alongside ours. Specify the APIs NVIDIA must expose to make that possible, and carry the patterns that work forward from one integration to the next.

• Own the benchmark evidence for GPU-accelerated analytics. Design and run TPC-H, TPC-DS, and ClickBench measurements against the strongest available CPU baselines, separate cold and warm behavior, and publish results that hold up to outside scrutiny. Use those results to establish where the acceleration case is proven, where it is not yet, and what has to change.

• Own the acceleration roadmap jointly with the projects and partners you work with: what gets built, in what order, and which technical bets are worth making. Earn that standing where the work happens, through upstream contribution and public design review in open source, and through joint architecture and roadmap planning with partner engineering leadership.

Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Come join us!

About the Team:

The User Management team owns the full identity lifecycle at AlphaSense - from creating and provisioning users, through managing their identities, to authenticating who they are and authorizing what they can do in the system. Our work spans three core domains:

• User Management - creating, provisioning, and managing user identities

• Authentication - verifying who users are

• Authorization - determining what users can do in the system

We are a product platform team, not a product team: we build the identity and access infrastructure that other engineering teams build on top of, rather than shipping user-facing features ourselves. We also act as a security guardrail for AlphaSense, since identity and access sit at the center of how the platform stays secure.

The team is well-established and senior, based in Helsinki, Finland, and pushing deliberately toward a true platform model - scaling our authentication and authorization systems so they can be safely self-served by teams across the company.

About the Role:

This is a Senior Engineer role on the team that manages identity and access for AlphaSense's entire, and constantly growing, customer base, and that nearly every product engineering team depends on for user and entitlement data. You'll work across all three pillars of identity: creating and managing users, authenticating them, and authorizing what they can do - designing systems built to scale with a constantly growing number of users. Security is core to this role, not adjacent to it - you'll work closely with our security teams to make sure what we build is secure by design, in an environment governed by SOC2 and GDPR.

We're looking for a strong, self-sufficient engineer with solid experience building and operating identity, authentication, or authorization platforms at scale, ideally in a platform/product-platform engineering context. You can take deep technical ownership of complex problems and execute independently, while contributing ideas and input into our broader roadmap alongside the rest of the team. You're genuinely interested in security, comfortable partnering closely with security teams on secure-by-design systems, and ready to work closely, day-to-day, with the rest of the team here in Helsinki.

We're hiring a strong, hands-on Product Manager to own CodeRabbit's security product: the AI-driven scanner that hunts for real vulnerabilities across entire codebases and surfaces security findings directly in pull request reviews. The product combines LLM-based vulnerability hunting with static analysis, secrets detection, infrastructure-as-code checks, and dependency and supply-chain analysis, and grades every finding for exploitability and severity before a customer ever sees it.

This is a high-ownership IC role.

One thing we're firm on: you must come from the security space. This product lives or dies on security judgment - what a true positive looks like, what severity a finding deserves, and what an AppSec team actually needs before it will trust a scanner.

Build the public sector security program that will help Chainguard earn and maintain trust with government customers.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. ポジションについて

日本のシニア ソリューションコンサルタントとして、複雑な商談をリードし、営業と対等な立場で戦略を組み立てていただくポジションです。AI 翻訳、Language AI を用いた業務ワークフロー、API、そしてリアルタイム多言語コミュニケーションを実現する DeepL Voice まで、製品全体を扱っていただきます。主な対象は日本のエンタープライズ顧客です。

資料を作ることが中心の役割ではありません。ご自身で製品に触れ、デモやプロトタイプ、PoV 環境を組み上げていただく、手を動かすポジションです。

営業担当と商談の全過程で密に組み、マーケティング、プロダクト、カスタマーサクセスと連携しながら、提案した内容を確実に実現していただきます。

日本のチームはまだ小さく、その分、一人ひとりの影響範囲が大きいポジションです。チームがこれまでに積み上げてきたものもありますが、まだ手が回っていない領域も残っています。あるものをより良くでき、ないものは自分で作れる方、そして与えられた枠の中で動くだけでなく、ソリューションコンサルティングの進め方そのものを形づくっていきたいと考えている方を求めています。

主な職務内容

- 中〜高難度の商談において、ディスカバリー、デモ、ソリューション設計を主体的に担う。ビジネス価値と製品を結びつけ、深い技術ディスカバリー、作り込んだデモ、的確な反論処理によって受注率を高める

- パイロットや POC を実施し、適切な営業手法を用いながら、受注に対して実質的に貢献する

- 複数の商談を並行して、細かな管理を必要とせずに進め、高い顧客満足を維持する

- 複雑な商談において、担当カウンターパートとのコミュニケーションと関係構築を担う。役員クラスも対象に含み、部門をまたいだ関係づくりを進める

- 営業担当とアカウント戦略をともに検討する。アカウント全体の状況の中で個々の商談を捉え、他の DeepL 製品が入る余地を見極める

- 技術的な実現可能性、ソリューションの語り方、競合との差別化について、営業を導く

- 法務、情報セキュリティ、プロダクト、マーケティングとの社内議論において、ソリューションコンサルティングの立場を代表する。技術的な価値を、ビジネス側にも技術側にも伝わる形で示す

- RFI、RFP のプロセスを自律的に推進する

- ジュニアのソリューションコンサルタントに対し、デモ、ツール、進め方についてコーチングを行う。社内のガイドやドキュメント、トレーニングに貢献する

- 現場で得た知見を構造化してプロダクトおよびエンジニアリングに還元し、製品と提案の質を高める

求める経験・スキル

- 日本語：ネイティブレベル。英語：ビジネスレベル（ネイティブレベルの英語力は求めていません）。その他の言語ができる方は歓迎します

- ソリューションコンサルタント、セールスエンジニア、プリセールスとしての顧客対応経験5年以上。エンタープライズ SaaS、AI、CCaaS、言語技術、またはそれに準じる領域での経験が望ましい

- 複雑な商談において、ディスカバリー、デモ、ソリューション設計を主体的に担い、受注の成否に直接貢献してきた実績

- 複数の商談を並行して、細かな管理を必要とせずに進められること

- 技術的な土台。REST API、認証および SSO（SAML、OAuth、OpenID Connect、Azure AD）、一般的な SaaS 連携パターンについて、お客様の前で語れるレベル。日常的にコードを書く必要はありません

- セキュリティおよびコンプライアンスへの確かな理解。情報システム部門や法務部門と会話できること

- RFI、RFP プロセスの推進経験

- 高いプレゼンテーション力とコミュニケーション力。ビジネス側と技術側、どちらの相手にも合わせられること

- 業界動向や競合情報への関心。案件のあとに、うまくいったこととそうでなかったことを振り返る習慣

このポジションと DeepL のミッションに共感いただけるものの、すべての要件を満たしていないと感じて応募を迷われている方も、ぜひご応募ください。DeepL が大切にしているのは、これまでのご経験の完璧さではなく、これから一緒に生み出せる価値と成長です。まずはお会いできることを楽しみにしています。

title: Senior Software Engineer, Identity & Access Discovery
description:
Description
Keeper Security is hiring an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Privileged Access Management team and lead backend development for Discovery capabilities within KeeperPAM. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL or El Dorado Hills, CA metro areas.
Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help build the systems that discover and secure privileged identities and infrastructure across complex enterprise environments.
About Keeper
Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.
About the Job
As a Senior Software Engineer on Keeper's PAM Discovery team, you will be a primary developer for the backend discovery service that identifies privileged accounts, service accounts, keys and machines across Active Directory, cloud IAM, databases and endpoints so they can be brought under secure management and rotation. This is primarily a backend engineering role, most of your time will be spent building services, data pipelines and integrations in Python, with some Java/Kotlin work on our cloud services and occasional changes to our TypeScript/React administrative interface.
What makes this problem interesting: Discovery runs on gateways deployed inside customer environments that Keeper cannot access directly, so the system has to be resilient, self-diagnosing and safe even when debugging access is limited and deployed versions vary. And Keeper's zero-knowledge architecture requires discovered data to be encrypted before it leaves the customer environment, which rules out most of the conventional answers for how that data can be processed, indexed and presented.
Responsibilities

• Design and develop the Python discovery engine that runs on customer-deployed gateways, and the Java/Kotlin cloud services that store and serve discovered data

• Build systems that discover privileged accounts, service accounts, keys, machines and related identity data across Active Directory, cloud IAM, databases and endpoints

• Solve identity correlation and reconciliation challenges, including determining when accounts discovered across multiple systems represent the same principal

• Build incremental re-scan and state-reconciliation capabilities that maintain an accurate view of customer environments without accumulating duplicate or stale data

• Build the test coverage and diagnostic tooling that let us trust code we can't debug in the field: unit, integration and automated tests, plus logging and error reporting good enough to root-cause an issue from a customer's logs alone

• Design discovery workflows that operate safely inside customer production networks, respecting API limits, limiting blast radius and remaining resilient to partial failures across large environments

• Develop secure data-processing workflows that operate within Keeper’s zero-knowledge architecture and protect discovered data throughout collection, transmission and storage

• Collaborate with Product, QA and other PAM engineers on technical design, testing, troubleshooting and delivery of Discovery features

• Use AI-assisted too

title: Senior Google Ads Buyer, DTC eCommerce
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
Google is where we are putting our next round of growth. You would own a set of those accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact and there is nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created

title: Trust & Safety Lead (Technical) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission
nebenan.de connects real neighbours under their real names. That only works if people feel safe here. Your mission is to keep our users safe: with technical safeguards built into our platform and API, with product features that help neighbours protect themselves, and in close partnership with our Community Management team.
You look at everything security first. You ask how someone could attack the trust of our users, and you prevent it before it happens. At the same time you think in products, not only in backend systems: a well-placed warning in the interface, a clear reporting flow, or a safer default setting often protects more people than another rule on the server.
Concretely, you will:
Build safety into the platform

Design and implement technical safeguards in our API and backend: abuse detection, rate limiting, verification checks, and the signals that catch fake accounts and scams early.
Ship user-facing safety features. Reporting flows, warnings on suspicious messages, blocking and privacy controls, safer defaults. Safety that users can see and use.
Threat-model new features before they ship. Ask how a bad actor would abuse them, and design the friction and detection against it.

Think security first

Stay current on how attacks on social platforms evolve: account takeover, fake accounts, romance and marketplace scams, phishing and QR lures, spam rings, coordinated harassment.
Lead the response when something is spreading or someone is at risk: decide, act, then close the route it came through.
Decide what we build ourselves and what we buy. Where the market already solves a problem, such as content scanning, evaluate it, buy it and integrate it. Build where the problem is specific to nebenan.

Work as one with Community Management

Our moderation team handles cases day to day.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
THE ROLE

 

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV).  You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches,  implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.

Key responsibilities:

- Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance

- Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback

- Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles

- Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements

- Work  with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features

REQUIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

- Strong fundamentals in control theory, with depth in one or more of  optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems 

- Practical experience developing, tuning and validating control or motion systems on real world physical systems

- Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++

- Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software

- Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour  in complex robotic systems across software and hardware

DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

- Applied experience with model predictive control, trajectory optimization, motion planning etc. 

- Direct experience with mobile robotics or autonomous vehicle systems

- Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls

- Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)

- Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components

 

This is a full-time role based in our office in London, England.  At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Owning a portfolio of fleet customers end to end, from onboarding through to renewal, with clear accountability for keeping them

- Handling inbound policy queries from customers and brokers by phone and email, resolving them quickly and helping people self-serve where that suits them better

- Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

- Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

- Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

- Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

- Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

- Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

- Hunger to learn and real coachability. We will teach you the insurance and the telematics

- Clear written and spoken communication, with a knack for making complex things easy to understand, and the confidence to present to clients

- A proactive attitude to getting the job done, even when the answer takes some digging

- Organisation across a busy and varied workload, with the accuracy and attention to detail to match the pace

- Evidence you already use AI tools to work better, or a genuine appetite to build that habit fast

- Desirable, not required: time working with fleets, or exposure to motor insurance

 

BENEFITS

- 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

- Share Incentive Plan 📈

- Workplace Pension 💰

- Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

- Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work

title: Academic Research to UX Research Career Changer
description:
About the Program:
Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:
The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

Who We Are

Verkada is the leading cloud-managed physical security platform, uniting hardware, software, and AI to deliver enterprise-scale security and insights. At the core of our mission is video-powering everything from real-time monitoring to historical playback for tens of thousands of organizations worldwide.

The Streaming team owns the full-stack infrastructure powering the video experience for over 1M+.4M Verkada cameras. We take on complex streaming challenges to deliver live and recorded video with unmatched speed, reliability, and security. By continually advancing our technology, we ensure that every frame-whether live or months old-is always available instantly, seamlessly, and securely.

About the Role

As an Embedded Engineer (Video Streaming) , you will design and implement streaming features that power our 1M+.4M deployed cameras (and next generation cameras). You’ll collaborate with firmware, backend, and native client teams to build and own a highly performant streaming capture experience for live and history videos. At the same time, you’ll help make our firmware components more efficient, secure and future-proof.

What You'll Do

• Design, develop, and optimize embedded video encoding and streaming pipelines for Verkada’s camera and security devices.

• Implement and tune hardware-accelerated video codecs (H.264, H.265/HEVC, AV1) for performance, quality, and low power consumption.

• Build and extend multimedia frameworks (e.g., GStreamer, FFmpeg) to support real-time video capture, processing, and delivery.

• Integrate and optimize streaming protocols (RTSP, RTP, RTMP, HLS, DASH, WebRTC) for low-latency, reliable video transport at scale.

• Profile and optimize startup time (TTFF), latency, rebuffering, and overall video QoE metrics.

• Debug issues in encoding pipelines, transport layers, and device utilization (CPU/GPU/ISP).

What You Bring

• BS or MS degree in Computer Science (or similar degree).

• 5+ years of professional experience in embedded systems development, with a focus on video streaming applications.

• Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded Linux environments.

• Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week.

Nice to Have

• Strong hands-on experience with video codecs (H.264, H.265/HEVC, AV1) and hardware-accelerated encoding/decoding pipelines.

• Familiarity with multimedia frameworks such as GStreamer, FFmpeg, or custom video pipelines.

• Solid understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTP, RTMP, HLS, DASH, WebRTC) and adaptive bitrate streaming.

• Experience optimizing for low latency and startup time (TTFF) under constrained resources.

title: Técnico de Neumáticos de Viaje
description:
Summary

El Técnico de Neumáticos se especializa en la inspección, reparación y reemplazo de neumáticos en vehículos livianos, incluidos automóviles y camiones. Las responsabilidades clave incluyen reparar fugas, balancear, rotar los neumáticos, asegurar una correcta inflación y adherirse a los estándares de seguridad de los neumáticos. Los Técnicos de Neumáticos también son responsables de asesorar a los clientes sobre el mantenimiento de los neumáticos para mejorar el rendimiento y la longevidad. Los candidatos deben tener un teléfono inteligente moderno con una conexión a Internet activa para gestionar eficientemente los pedidos y asignaciones a través de la aplicación de la empresa. La habilidad para navegar por aplicaciones móviles, plataformas digitales y flujos de trabajo basados en aplicaciones es esencial para una ejecución fluida de tareas y comunicación.

La compensación varía entre $37,440 y $66,560 por año, según la experiencia y la disponibilidad.

Job Specifics

• Inspeccionar y evaluar el estado de los neumáticos en busca de desgaste, daños o defectos.

• Reparar pinchazos o fugas utilizando las técnicas de parcheo adecuadas.

• Montar, balancear y rotar los neumáticos para un rendimiento óptimo del vehículo.

• Asegurar la correcta inflación de los neumáticos y el cumplimiento de los estándares de seguridad.

• Asesorar a los clientes sobre el mantenimiento de los neumáticos, incluidos los horarios de rotación y las necesidades de reemplazo.

• Mantener un espacio de trabajo limpio y organizado mientras se siguen los protocolos de seguridad.

Qualifications and Experience

Qualifications

• Diploma de secundaria o equivalente GED.

• Experiencia en reparación, montaje y balanceo de neumáticos.

• Conocimiento básico de los estándares de seguridad de neumáticos y las mejores prácticas.

Experience

• Certificación en reparación de neumáticos o campo relacionado.

• Más de 2 años de experiencia en servicio, reparación y mantenimiento de neumáticos.

• Conocimiento de técnicas avanzadas de servicio de neumáticos y herramientas.

• Fuerte atención a los protocolos de seguridad y la limpieza del lugar de trabajo.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect (CustomerLake)
description:
Req: FEQ427R110
Location: Tokyo, Japan

Marketing teams are stuck between fragmented customer data and martech stacks that copy that data into proprietary silos while customers expect real-time, personalized experiences. Customer Lake, the agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP) built natively into Databricks, changes that equation. It unifies first- and third-party data into governed Customer 360 profiles, resolves identities, and uses agents to build audiences, recommend next-best actions, and activate campaigns across channels, all without copying data out of the Lakehouse or adding vendor lock-in.

 

The Solutions Architect (Customer Lake) team is part of a dedicated, global go-to-market organization focused on driving adoption and revenue growth for Customer Lake, Databricks’ agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP) built natively into the Data Intelligence Platform. The Customer Lake SA will engage clients across business units and verticals, build relationships with marketing and data stakeholders, position Customer Lake in depth, and deliver presentations, demos, and POCs that drive informed adoption decisions. They will understand the guardrails and the steps needed to successfully land and expand Customer Lake as clients deliver on their customer engagement and growth objectives.

 

The impact you will have

• Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on customer data and marketing projects, ranging from architectural design to data engineering to identity resolution, audience activation, and agent deployment

• Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory, driving Customer Lake adoption from initial Customer 360 build-out through full CDP augmentation or replacement.

• As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect building technical credibility with CMOs, heads of marketing technology (MarTech), data engineering leaders, and marketing and analytics teams to drive product adoption and vision.

• Enable clients at scale through workshops, POC execution, and developing customer-facing collateral that increases technical knowledge and demonstrates the value of an embedded, agentic CDP architecture.

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll own complex product and technical problems across the merchant experience, from problem definition through design, implementation, production, and ongoing evolution.

You'll:

- Design, build, and operate production systems across backend services and user-facing applications.

- Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

- An AI-first mindset, with strong experience leveraging modern AI tools alongside solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

Le ou la coach de transition de carrière accompagne les participants des programmes d’outplacement Careerminds, individuellement et/ou en groupe, dans leur développement de carrière et leur recherche d’emploi.

• Une expertise en développement de carrière, incluant notamment la planification de carrière, le personal branding, la préparation de CV, les entretiens, le networking, les réseaux sociaux et la recherche d’emploi en ligne.
